== Acquisition ==
'''[[Skill trainer]]s'''
* [[Michiko]] ([[Kaineng Center]])

== Notes ==
* When using this skill, [[Energy hiding|energy can be hidden]] to meet the requirement for the energy gain. 
* [[Hero]]es cannot effectively use this skill as they will begin to use it when they are at the upper cap, thus overpassing it due to natural energy regeneration and receiving no energy.
* The energy gain from [[Scribe's Insight]] is applied before this skill checks your current energy.
